tools.name: air_quality
tools.description: FREE. Latest Air Quality Health Index (AQHI 1–10+) and risk level at the station nearest a Canadian postal code.

tools.name: aqhi_forecast
tools.description: PRO. AQHI forecasts for the nearest station (next periods), plus the current observation.

tools.name: sites_check
tools.description: PRO. Current AQHI for up to 25 postal codes, worst first — e.g. wildfire smoke checks for sites, schools or crews.

tools.name: region_watch
tools.description: PRO. All AQHI stations within a radius (km, max 400) of a postal code with readings at or above a threshold.
